source: Exact previously certified F5 historical-development outcome bundle; preserve source SHA. Team identities and strictly prior completed games only; no lineup, starter, exact lines, target-game postgame features or prospective outcomes.
mechanism: Joint opponent-adjusted offense/defense count regression. Each prior game contributes two run-count observations. log(mu)=intercept+home_indicator*home_effect+scoring_team_offense+opponent_defense. Shared NB2 shape fixed2, variance mu+mu^2/2. Separate offense/defense team effects fitted jointly on the schedule graph, not independently pooled team averages or a latent margin/Kalman state. Model HOME/AWAY/DRAW by independent NB count convolution, conditional ML excludes draw.
training: Same-season expanding history, refit first game date of each calendar month with>=600 strictly earlier games. Predict complete date before admitting date outcomes to history; reset every season. Fit team inventory derived only from training history; require both teams at least20 games in the fitted history. No cross-season carry.50 maximum Fisher-scoring iterations with dense SPD solve; component steps clipped[-.5,.5]; stop if max step<1e-8. Nonconverged max final step>1e-6 abstains for whole fit; no solver retry parameters. Initial intercept log smoothed league mean, other coefficients0. L2 penalties1e-6 intercept,10 home effect,20 offense/defense coefficients. log means clipped[-5,log50] as fixed numerical bound. No validation tuning or dispersion estimation.
settlement: Confidence>=0.75 conditional HOME or AWAY. Exact F5 equal scores are pushes. Count PMF recurrence to tail<1e-12, maximum10000 terms; throw if mass tolerance not met. No actual betting lines/odds/ROI implied.
baseline: Prior league modal HOME/AWAY on identical selected nonpush cohort; also all eligible. Additional descriptive monthly/LOMO/Wilson/Beta/concentration metrics use shared frozen reporting helper; F7-specific additional robustness policy is reported separately, not a replacement for F5 base gates.
tuning: Single joint count-regression architecture, fixed shape/penalties/solver; no hyperparameter grids or post-result variants. Close if FAIL, preserve prior candidates. Stop for authorization if historical gates pass; never open external automatically.
